title: Local Lead Enrichment Engine
description: Enrich local business leads with domain intelligence, online presence, and review health scores.

locationQuery.title: Location
locationQuery.description: Free-form query for location, e.g. 'Chennai, India' or 'San Francisco, CA'.

radiusMeters.title: Search radius (meters)
radiusMeters.description: The search radius for finding candidates around the location query.

industryKeywords.title: Industry / category keywords
industryKeywords.description: List of keywords to search for. E.g., ['digital marketing agency', 'dentist'].

minReviewRating.title: Minimum review rating
minReviewRating.description: Filter candidates with review rating greater than or equal to this.

minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count
minReviewCount.description: Filter candidates with review count greater than or equal to this.

maxBusinesses.title: Maximum businesses to fetch
maxBusinesses.description: Maximum number of candidate businesses to process.

enableDomainIntelligence.title: Enrich domain intelligence (WHOIS, tech stack)
enableDomainIntelligence.description: If enabled, performs WHOIS and tech stack enrichment for business websites.

enableReviewAndSocialChecks.title: Enrich review and social presence
enableReviewAndSocialChecks.description: If enabled, searches for review platforms and social media profiles.

googleMapsSourceActorId.title: Local data source Actor ID
googleMapsSourceActorId.description: Apify actor ID of a local business / Maps actor (e.g. 'apify/google-maps-scraper' or 'sparkling_yardstick/local-business-data-api').

domainIntelActorId.title: Domain intelligence Actor ID
domainIntelActorId.description: Apify actor ID of a domain intelligence scraper (e.g., WHOIS/DNS/tech stack).

reviewIntelActorId.title: Review / social intel Actor ID
reviewIntelActorId.description: Apify actor ID of a review/social profiles scraper.

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API token override
apifyApiToken.description: Optional Apify API token override. If empty, uses default token from environment.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxies used for web requests. Enabled by default.
